page_title: BHA 4-1 LUT | Brighton v Luton 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' 4 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Evan Ferguson (Brighton). Pervis Estupinan plays a fantastic through ball and finds Evan Ferguson (Brighton), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
90+2' Luton will take a corner kick.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Brighton force a corner. They send men into the box.
89' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brighton.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Pedro leaves the pitch and Julio Enciso (Brighton) comes on.
88' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cauley Woodrow (Luton) replacing Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu.
88' Substitution. Tahith Chong makes way for Luke Berry (Luton).
87' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!

85' 3 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Simon Adingra (Brighton) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:1.
81' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Carlton Morris (Luton) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Jason Steele no chance!
80' Referee David Coote is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Luton!
80' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Luton using VAR. Let's see what happens.
80' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area. Luton are awarded a penalty!
79' That's the end of the game for James Milner, who is replaced by Joel Veltman (Brighton).
78' Substitution. Danny Welbeck walks off the pitch and Evan Ferguson (Brighton) comes on as a substitute.
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mads Juel Andersen as he is replaced by Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton).
74' Here is a change. Mahmoud Dahoud is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Billy Gilmour (Brighton).
74' It is time for a substitution. Simon Adingra (Brighton) is on for Solly March.
71' 2 - 0 Goal! Joao Pedro (Brighton) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Thomas Kaminski into right side of the goal.
71' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' Tom Lockyer (Luton) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton are about to take a penalty!
66' The ball is out of play and Luton manage to earn a corner.
65' The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
64' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Alfie Doughty (Luton) replaces Issa Kabore.
64' Here's the change. Elijah Adebayo leaves the pitch and Jacob Brown (Luton) comes on as a substitute.

64' Solly March (Brighton) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Thomas Kaminski makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
59' Issa Kabore (Luton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
57' Luton earn a corner.
56' The Luton players are exchanging some short passes.
52' Pascal Gross (Brighton) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
51' Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
50' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
49' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' Joao Pedro (Brighton) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
46' Brighton force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' David Coote blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Great ball in from Ryan Giles. Carlton Morris (Luton) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) makes a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
43' Solly March (Brighton) works the corner short.
42' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
39' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Danny Welbeck (Brighton). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
38' Luton get a corner.
38' Carlton Morris (Luton) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
38' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Solly March (Brighton) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header into the roof of the net after a good run and cross by Kaoru Mitoma.
33' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
30' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Luton.
30' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
28' Joao Pedro (Brighton) passes the ball onto Kaoru Mitoma, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
27' Great teamplay by Brighton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
23' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
23' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
22' David Coote interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Issa Kabore (Luton).

21' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Thomas Kaminski pulls off an easy save.
20' Carlton Morris (Luton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Brighton win a corner.
18' Solly March (Brighton) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
17' David Coote blows his whistle and signals a foul after Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Brighton.
16' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) swings it in and Pascal Gross gets on the end of it, but Thomas Kaminski shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
14' Pascal Gross (Brighton) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
12' Luton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' What a great effort! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
7' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
6' Joao Pedro (Brighton) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
5' Luton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
2' The ball is out of play. Brighton win a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Luton will take the kick-off.
David Coote will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
